purpose: Stage and independently review the inert Local Mistral authority-binding verifier that makes immutable repository authority stronger than all supplied runtime identity arguments and validates conversion evidence fail closed.
requiredInvariants: PR #5317 is already merged into authority base 761d3954ea1b2691d7a0c2d627d89c4f2b5c8b8d; no review or self-audit from the former stacked head may be reused for this segment.
The staged authority-binding verifier is not executed or referenced by any workflow or product path in this PR.
The Local Mistral authority manifest is loaded only from the bootstrap directory, must be a bounded regular non-symlink JSON file and must match the strict v1 schema and authority rules.
Git commit identities are validated as 40-hex Git object ids; content and artifact digests are validated as 64-hex SHA-256 values.
Conversion root and artifact paths are derived from and constrained by immutable authority; relative paths cannot be replaced by arbitrary caller paths.
Supplied legacy runtime identity arguments must have exactly the expected key set, exact Python types and exact values from immutable authority; mismatch fails closed.

Conversion report raw SHA-256 and canonical self-digest are both verified; report/source-verification schema, exact main, run id, run attempt, toolchain status, Mistral revision, source-files digest, source-manifest digest, model artifact SHA/size and llama-server SHA/size are bound to authority.
Duplicate or malformed source/output collections and file digest/stat I/O failures fail closed with fixed error codes.
No evidence, review, attestation, provider status or workflow publication is activated by this segment.
Local Qwen remains the independent reviewer for this Mistral-only authority change.
No product, API, database, RBAC, registration, cabinet, customer-data or production-routing behavior changes.
Production hosting remains REG_RU_VPS_ONLY and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
